name: Floating Markets
description: In many cities and villages, traditional shops on boats resemble small red houses anchored in the middle of rivers. Many of these boats sell exotic teas made by rare herbs that can uplift the spirit (its cost range from 50 gp to 200 gp). To activate their powers, on a ceremony, all participants say the word Kampai and drink simultaneously. Then, a ceremonial master casts a specific spell, reciting the name of Tenshikin, and the effects last for 4 hours. The herbs can be obtained in Yama Bunkatsu forest. The warrior caste commonly consumes: Tea of Cherry Blossom. The spirit becomes lighter. The creature’s speed increases by 10 feet, and it can walk in water and difficult terrain with no penalties. Tea of Lotus. The spirit becomes resolved. Your attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 17, 18, 19, or 20. Tea of Plum Blossom. The spirit becomes protected. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and gains the Deflect Arrow ability (see monk’s class and consider a character level instead of monk level).
